breakdown.description: The prompt collapses the distributed self-weight into a single end load and calls it exact, even though the axial force from self-weight varies continuously along the bar.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The original prompt incorrectly instructed to replace the distributed self-weight with a single concentrated load and treat it as the exact axial force. The ground truth correctly removes this instruction. The generated specification, however, keeps this incorrect instruction, stating: 'For the elongation calculation, model the self-weight as a single concentrated load equal to the total weight, applied at the free end. Use this concentrated load as the exact axial force P(x) along the bar.' This directly contradicts the ground truth and repeats the user's error.
